item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 16/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the cloud band covering southern China thinning out today, daytime temperatures will rise over the region in the next couple of days. Under the persistent influence of a dry northeast monsoon and its replenishments, the weather will be generally fine over Guangdong in the next few days. It will remain cool in the morning over the coastal areas, and it will be cold over inland areas. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Wind: Northeast force 4.
Weather: Very dry. Rather cool in the morning. Becoming fine during the day.
Temp range: 14 - 19 C
R.H. range: 30 - 55 per Cent
